'''Agmor Glayyd''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Mor]] of [[House Glayyd]] on the planet [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. He groomed his son, [[Ewwen Glayyd|Ewwen]], to take his place as the head of the clan. He also unsuccessfully encouraged his strong-willed daughter, [[Ido Glayyd|Ido]], to hew to their culture's patriarchal values and find an appropriate suitor within the clan.<ref name="HSCS" />

Agmor earned the disapproval of the [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] [[Magg]] and [[Zlarb/Legends|Zlarb]], despite his clan's facilitation of their activities. Zlarb, a [[Malkite Poisoners|Malkite Poisoner]],<ref name="HSR" /> managed to poison Agmor's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]<ref name="HSCS" /> without drawing any suspicion from the family. After Agmor died, Ewwen was thrust into the role of Mor. Half a month later, after [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] saved Ewwen from having to fight a duel with the famed gunman, [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]], Ewwen learned of Zlarb's treachery and turned over the data regarding his clan's dealings with the slavery ring over to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] as a means of pursuing vengeance for his father's [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="HSR" />
